profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer

positions.title: Product Owner, Engine Supervisory Controls
positions.description: Created and executed the technical vision of the controls and software for engine torque delivery for the full vehicle fleet. Owned and pruned backlog. Increased on-time software delivery, reduced technical debt, and successfully re-architected system to expedite the integration of future engines. Expanded skills of team members through focused coaching and deliberate stretch assignments resulting in a more agile scrum with fewer personnel dependencies.

positions.title: Controls Design Engineer, Engine Torque
positions.description: Led design and implementation of controls algorithms for industry leading engine control software. Improved software development, deployment, and testing process to radically increase the speed to solutions from weeks to hours.

positions.title: TRACK Engineer
positions.description: Completed 6 engineering rotations focused on software and controls projects for improving EV charging experience, hybrid efficiency, engine drive quality, and transmission safety diagnostics.

positions.title: Resident Computer Consultant (RCC)
positions.description: Assisted residential students with their computing needs such as network connectivity, software access, computer repairs, etc. Taught over-subscribed courses on computing essentials and digital media creation (Photoshop, iMovie, GarageBand, etc.).

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Designed and fabricated prototypes to increase the robustness and durability of smart mouth guards designed to sense traumatic brain injury. Verified results using advanced image processing algorithms.

positions.title: Embedded Systems Intern
positions.description:
Developed automated testing rigs for IPX4 water ingress and long-term battery performance.
Improved manufacturing station design to streamline production processes.

positions.title: Head Coordinator of Opportunity Job Fair
positions.description: Organized and managed a team of 16 students and 4 staff members to successfully host the Opportunity Job Fair and Reception. The fair welcomed more than 130 companies and over 1500 students.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Designing a simple, stable, and efficient robot for the next iteration of the RoboCup.
